ProviderId.description: Any agent id in the runtime's agent registry: a built-in id or one contributed by an enabled plugin (`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}$`). The runtime rejects ids it does not know; `provider.list` is the source of truth.

QuickLaunchShell.description: Quick Launch: per-project saved commands, each run as an ordinary managed terminal session in a chosen worktree. One active run per command and worktree root (the runtime admits atomically and returns the existing run).

QuickLaunchKind.description: `service` keeps running (dev server, API); `task` is expected to exit (build, test). Only changes wording/defaults.

AgentReviewScope.description: Independent agent review (Agent Changes): a fresh Chat of the chosen agent reviews a snapshot of a session's changes, captured when the review starts. `checkpoints` is the `review.changes` range (`to` omitted: the current files); `uncommitted` is the worktree against git HEAD, untracked files included.
